problem_type: Merge admission confuses hosted display counts and lossy patches with complete immutable tree evidence
symptom: Original PR #2 diff406 plus unknown policy cutoff caused false clean. The first fix then falsely rejected complete local Git=6797 versus GitHub=6807 because rename display algorithms differ.
direct_cause: Originally view.files remains available but diff errors clear added text and unknown cutoff grants legacy. In 23d, rename-grouped record count is incorrectly equated with GitHub changed_files; only changed blobs are touched, NO_LAZY_FETCH is ignored by Apple Git 2.39, and binary attributes can suppress text. Filtering all +++ lines also drops actual added source starting ++.
class_root: Admission must prove full object/tree/path/patch coverage for immutable PR endpoints separately from hosted rename presentation, and unknown evidence cannot create success or historical exemption.
affected_population: Large PRs with differing rename heuristics
Missing commit/tree/blob or malformed endpoint metadata
Binary attributes and arbitrary file suffixes
internal_only_reason: The defect is internal error-to-success conversion. Reuse the repository's existing Git path decoder and actual local Git executable; regression uses real commit objects and isolated gh transport fixtures, without asserting hosted network behavior.
invariants: Resolve complete PR metadata from the requested target repository and PR number, with explicit base/head commit SHAs and changed_files
Read paths and added lines from the same SHA-bound three-point Git diff, never the current checkout or an unbound hosted diff
Validate complete raw tree path coverage before classification; hosted rename counts must lie within raw-min(A,D) through raw, not equal one guessed threshold
Check all local snapshot blobs and tree traversal; every Git subprocess blocks all protocols with scoped GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL even when old Git ignores NO_LAZY_FETCH

Force full textual diff without textconv/external diff and preserve the 64MiB output ceiling; attributes and arbitrary suffixes cannot hide cancellation text; a distinct native added-line indicator prevents source/header ambiguity
Historical exemption requires two valid timestamps and a strictly earlier createdAt; unknown policy time enforces current rules
Keep four-class, design-card and independent-acceptance rules unchanged; the existing src/**/*.tsx path wildcard must include legal newline filenames

door_reduction.why_not: Generated by mapDoors/doorsForTargets over scripts including tests for readPullRequestChanges,classifyChange,isGrandfathered,gitNameStatus,gitPaths,splitNulPaths,readCompleteTrees,repositorySlug; before reads HEAD versions of the three changed source files, after reads saved source. Existing utility consumers keep inherited defaults. Four additional read doors are the tree/repo/NUL completeness boundaries and direct transport regression, not alternate admission paths. All 25 consumer files are counted; no global environment is changed.

generality_proof: All admission callers verify endpoint identity, commit objects, unique merge-base, recursively readable snapshot trees and every snapshot blob. The complete no-renames path/status set must exactly equal the mode/type/OID tree delta. Distinct hosted rename counts are accepted only inside the proven one-to-one A/D grouping interval, never by guessing a threshold. Real Git/CLI mutations reject missing patch, missing/duplicate/substituted paths even when totals look plausible, missing unchanged objects, endpoint conflicts, implicit transport attempts and binary-hidden cancellation text. Original strict-cutoff and valid-legacy controls remain.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Bind target repository/PR metadata and fail before classification when complete evidence is unavailable
Prove exact immutable tree/path/text coverage and mathematically feasible hosted rename grouping
Traverse all three snapshot trees and batch-check their blobs before trusting a diff
Preserve canonical NUL parsing while forwarding per-invocation transport prohibition and buffer cap
Require positive chronological evidence for historical exemption

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Actual standalone subprocess uses real local Git and isolated failing hosted-diff/policy transport
The same main body is exercised with malformed metadata, missing objects and valid legacy evidence

Optional env/maxBuffer forwarding is tested with a missing tree in a promisor repo; transport canary remains uninvoked even without NO_LAZY_FETCH. Existing callers retain inherited defaults and NUL semantics.

recurrence.reason: Any rename algorithm, unavailable object, attribute setting or partial clone can repeat this class; a matching hosted number does not prove completeness.
same_class_scan: Read complete PR acquisition and policy/report tail
Read canonical Git NUL parser and its process environment defaults
Compared user-supplied real M50/M100/raw counts without selecting a threshold
Executed true edited/exact-rename Git fixtures and complete path mutation controls
Verified actual Apple Git 2.39.3 and isolated promisor transport positive/negative controls
Checked binary attributes, arbitrary suffixes and ++ source lines
Retained original classification/card/acceptance and strict-cutoff regressions

prevention.invariant: Only a complete immutable tree/object/path/patch proof may enter classification; only positive dates permit legacy exemption
prevention.failure_mode: Any object, path, patch, identity or grouping-range inconsistency returns nonzero; all object transports are prohibited locally
prevention.strategy: Use native no-renames tree delta, exact unique path/status coverage, forced textual diff with unambiguous added-line indicator, scoped protocol prohibition and bounded A/D rename grouping

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove hosted-count strong equality, rename-compressed classifier input and attribute/header-dependent text loss; earlier diff-error/unknown-time false successes stay removed. Preserve full A/D conservative classification and valid legacy compatibility.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No package or installed-Git replacement. The application now enforces transport prohibition with the stable GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL contract, verified on Apple Git 2.39.3 and with NO_LAZY_FETCH deliberately removed. No new dependency or production fetch is introduced.

migration: No project data migration. Callers must provide all three snapshot trees/blobs locally; missing data fails without implicit transport. Gitlinks are external commit pointers, not required local submodule objects.
residual_risks: Real hosted PR #2 re-execution and independent D review remain coordination acceptance; no real network request made here
No App, browser, benchmark, workflow or heavy gate run
The hosted interval checks mathematical rename feasibility, not GitHub similarity heuristics; full tree/path proof remains mandatory
Forced text can exceed the unchanged 64MiB cap on large binaries; this fails closed rather than truncating or raising the budget
Object checks cover the three relevant snapshots, not a full repository fsck or submodule checkout
